# BFFX Maintainers

This document lists the active maintainers of the BFFX project. Maintainers have write access to the repository, review pull requests, and steer the technical direction of the framework.

| Name | GitHub Handle | Role | Area of Focus |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|

| **Jawad** | [@jawad](https://github.com/jawad) | Core Maintainer | CLI, Developer Experience (DX), Storage Engines, Security |

## Contributing & Becoming a Maintainer

We welcome contributions from anyone! If you're interested in helping maintain BFFX:
1. Start by contributing high-quality pull requests to fix bugs or implement features.
2. Engage in discussions on active issues and pull requests, providing constructive feedback.
3. Help triage issues, write documentation, and support other community members.

Maintainer status is granted to community members who demonstrate consistent technical excellence, alignment with the project's vision, and positive community engagement over a sustained period of time.
